description: This file defines theme-related utility functions for a web application, including a function to get the Ocean Professional theme tokens and another to generate a categorical color palette based on the theme colors. It also includes a function to map categories to colors.

methods.name: getOceanTheme()
methods.description: Returns an object with theme tokens such as colors, typography, radius, and elevation for the Ocean Professional theme.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette(count)
methods.description: Generates a deterministic palette of colors for categorical series, seeded by Ocean theme colors, with support for more colors than seed size by manipulating hue, saturation, and lightness.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap(categories)
methods.description: Maps category names to specific colors using the categorical palette, ensuring consistent color assignment across categories.
